content.title: Goldman Sachs’s Private-Credit Company Struggles to Clean Up Soured Bets
content.summary: Goldman Sachs  has been trying to clean up a mess inside its publicly traded private-lending company for more than three years.  The bank’s business-development company,  Goldman Sachs BDC  is primarily a lender to middle-market corporations.  Thanks to souring loans, the per share value of Goldman BDC’s holdings has slid for seven straight quarters and its stock price has fallen even further.
